records.context: Selected lines processed by :func:`sanitize_path`, or ``""`` if resolving the configured path or reading the file fails. The entire file is read as UTF-8 with invalid bytes replaced before selecting lines.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.log_tail#3
records.source: Selected lines processed by :func:`sanitize_path`, or ``""`` if resolving the configured path or reading the file fails. The entire file is read as UTF-8 with invalid bytes replaced before selecting lines.
records.translation: 선택한 줄을 :func:`sanitize_path`로 처리한 텍스트입니다. 설정된 경로를 얻는 데 실패하거나 파일을 읽지 못하면 ``""``를 반환합니다. 줄을 선택하기 전에 파일 전체를 UTF-8로 읽으며 잘못된 바이트는 대체 문자로 처리합니다.
